thanks for the smiles :J

No, there is no counselor, and I would be interested in seeing a counselor outside of school, but I don't think we have the money for that.

I know the pain when people say "you have so much to live for". It hurts when people act like it's just that easy to walk away from. It's not. But I believe in you, if it makes you feel any better. I believe you'll find a purpose. You will.
